summary: Implemented nightwatch-core end-to-end: added cron.nightwatch config/types/schema, created src/cron/nightwatch.ts (defaults, tilde expansion, git-change detection, prompt builder, guarded run executor, Telegram delivery, idempotent job upsert/removal), wired gateway dispatch/startup integration in src/gateway/server-cron.ts, and added comprehensive tests in src/cron/nightwatch.test.ts plus dispatch/startup routing tests in src/gateway/server-cron.nightwatch.test.ts. Verification: pnpm vitest run src/cron/nightwatch.test.ts passed, full new suites passed, pnpm lint passed, pnpm build passed. Live smoke validated config writes + numeric chat ID parsing, nightwatch change-detected path (delivery attempt reached and failed only at network send), skip path on second run, and idempotent register/disable behavior via real CronService. Gateway service restart steps were not run because restart commands are disallowed in this run environment.
